verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core Templates plugin lets users insert pre-defined snippets of text into the active note, which covers defining reusable templates and applying them. The Daily notes core plugin creates date-based notes, which suggests support for recurring note types, but the evidence never says it applies templates. Missing for 10: evidence of template variables such as date and title, evidence that templates are applied automatically when creating recurring notes (e.g. daily notes using a template), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
